reasons: Claimed status is compliant: the cited paragraph (p0066) is only an independent-contractor/no-agency clause and contains no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-poaching restriction, so the cited text supports the compliance conclusion.

Our preferred position under NOSOLICIT is no non-solicit binding Customer; absence of any such covenant satisfies the preferred position, so no redline or counterparty comment is expected or provided — the unchanged paragraph and empty comment are correct for this status.
The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are artifacts of there being no non-solicit clause to measure; they do not indicate a defect here.
Rationale documents the fallback terms to demand if the Vendor later proposes a non-solicit, which is appropriate internal evidence without raising a negotiation issue.
